cities.name: San Marino City
cities.local_food_tip: Sanmarinske i italijanske lagane kombinacije: tjestenine, supe, bruschette, peciva i salate.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏰 Guaita Tower (Exterior). → 🏛️ Basilica di San Marino (Exterior). → ☕ Café in medieval streets.

Afternoon: 🎭 Old Town alley walk. → 🍽️ Lunch: pasta, salads, pastries. → 🌄 Cesta & Montale towers (Exterior viewpoints).

Sunset: 🌅 Monte Titano ridge views.

Night: 🌃 Quiet medieval streets + dessert cafés.
public_transport_tips: 🚡 Cable car connects San Marino City and Borgo Maggiore.
🚌 Local buses connect to Rimini in Italy.

cities.name: Borgo Maggiore
cities.local_food_tip: Topli hleb, peciva, paste, lagane italijanske i mediteranske kombinacije.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🎭 Market Square walk. → ☕ Local café.

Afternoon: 🌄 Lower Monte Titano viewpoints. → 🍽️ Light lunch: pasta, salads.

Sunset: 🌅 Hillside viewpoints.

Night: 🌃 Quiet village streets.
public_transport_tips: 🚡 Cable car to San Marino City.

cities.name: Serravalle
cities.local_food_tip: Pite, paste, lagane salate i mediteranska jela — jednostavno i ukusno.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌿 Parco Ausa walk. → ☕ Café on the main square.

Afternoon: 🛍️ Modern center streets. → 🍽️ Lunch: pasta, pizza, salads.

Sunset: 🌅 Hillside edges.

Night: 🌃 Calm modern neighborhood.
public_transport_tips: 🚌 Local buses connect to all towns.
